title: JarHacker
description:
A CLI tool for modifying Java applications directly inside a JAR file.

The standard approach is: unpack → compile → repack. JarHacker does this in one step — it takes a .java file, compiles it via the JavaCompiler API, and injects the .class directly into the archive without unpacking.

Useful for patching third-party libraries, debugging without sources, and exploring Java applications.
